programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Josh saddles up to investigate a scandal over the remains of Wild West legend Buffalo Bill Cody; a first-hand account claims Bill's body was stolen and buried 500 miles away; with new leads, Josh digs for the cowboy's grave and the truth.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Josh hunts for the truth about the Third Reich's Amerikabomber, a warplane designed to obliterate New York City; ruins of a mysterious Nazi underground city and top-secret weapons factories provide clues about Hitler's dream killing machine.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Josh dives the frigid waters of the Baltic Sea in search of a revolutionary Nazi submarine, the V-80; Hitler orders it scuttled to prevent the Allies from learning its secrets; Josh risks it all to bring the prototype to the surface.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: A survey reveals a submerged pirate lair located off the coast of Jamaica; using photogrammetry, Josh dives in to hunt for the $50M stolen treasure of Black Bart, the King of Pirates.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Josh hunts for missing Confederate gold, exploring a wagon train robbery site where stolen coins vanished; then, a fresh eyewitness lead points directly to Jefferson Davis's lost war chest.

programme.title: Expedition X
programme.desc: The team heads south to a haunted city: Savannah, Georgia; they investigate horrifying reports of violent paranormal activity inside one of its oldest buildings, the Sorrel-Weed House, where a family died in shocking circumstances.

programme.title: Expedition X
programme.desc: Heather and Phil continue their investigation of Savannah, Ga., America's haunted city; their quest takes them deep into the wilderness, where they discover a place of tragedy that many locals believe leads to powerful paranormal activity.

programme.title: Expedition X
